body:
Source: GitHub issue #678.
In packages/lesson-foundry/bin/lesson-foundry.mjs, --prompt-only checks malformed lines under --gate (lines 90-95) and then calls promptOnly(prompts) (exiting 0) before findUnbankedClusters is evaluated, so passing --gate --prompt-only exits 0 when unbanked recurring clusters exist.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC1: In packages/lesson-foundry/bin/lesson-foundry.mjs, when both --gate and --prompt-only are passed, evaluate findUnbankedClusters(clusters, outDir, existsSync, undefined, undefined, minSize, findings, 0.5) and call gateFail(...) with exit 2 if unbanked.length > 0 before calling promptOnly.
- AC2: CLI tests in packages/lesson-foundry/test/cli.test.mjs verify that --gate --prompt-only exits 2 when unbanked recurring clusters exist and exits 0 when all clusters are banked.
title: lesson-foundry: evaluate --gate unbanked-cluster check before --prompt-only short-circuits (#678)
